notice.ko: 공고 자동수집은 best-effort이며 누락 가능 — 아래 공식 잡보드에서 직접 확인 권장.
notice.en: Automated collection of postings is best-effort and may miss items — please confirm directly on the official job boards below.

context.ko: 시드 워치리스트(data/postdoc_watchlist.json)의 그룹 페이지와 잡보드를 매주 확인해 채웁니다. 2026-09-22 확인 결과, LBNL Helms 공고와 Ceder 그룹 모집은 그대로 살아 있었습니다. 마감일(9월 14일)이 지난 Gelion 공고는 목록에서 내렸습니다. Faraday 잡보드에서는 Agratas 항목이 ‘Senior Solid-State Scientist’에서 ‘Senior Mechanical Engineer (Li-ion Battery Cell Development)’로 바뀌어 제목과 설명을 고쳤고, CPI 공고는 그대로 남아 있었으며 Integrals Power의 Battery Chemical Scientist를 새로 추가했습니다. 같은 보드에 AESC의 선덜랜드 기가팩토리 다수 직군과 UKBIC의 Cell Development Engineer도 올라와 있으나 포닥 성격이 아니어서 별도 항목으로 올리지 않았습니다. MEET에서는 연구원(E 13 TV-L) 직함이 채용 페이지에서 아예 사라지고 학생 보조 1건만 남았습니다 — 직전 회차의 HTTP 410에 이어 자리 자체가 내려간 것으로 보여 항목을 ‘공석 없음’으로 고쳤습니다. HIU는 ‘현재 열린 자리’ 페이지에 단 한 건도 게시돼 있지 않았습니다. 케임브리지 화학과는 포닥 공고가 5건에서 2건으로 줄었고 연구분야가 목록에 표시되지 않아 배터리 여부를 확인할 수 없었습니다. ECS 잡보드(jobs.electrochem.org)는 네 회차 연속 HTTP 403으로 차단돼 Sandia 항목은 또 재확인하지 못했습니다. data/pi_archive.json은 98명을 기록 중이나 flag가 붙은 PI가 아직 한 명도 없어 ‘아카이브 2회+’ 항목은 이번에도 추가하지 않았습니다.
context.en: This list is filled each week by checking the group pages and job boards in the seed watchlist (data/postdoc_watchlist.json). As of 22 September 2026 the LBNL Helms posting and the Ceder group's recruitment are both still live. The Gelion posting, whose 14 September deadline has passed, has been taken off the list. On the Faraday board the Agratas entry has changed from 'Senior Solid-State Scientist' to 'Senior Mechanical Engineer (Li-ion Battery Cell Development)', so its title and description were corrected; the CPI role is unchanged, and Integrals Power's Battery Chemical Scientist has been added. The same board also carries AESC's many Sunderland gigafactory roles and UKBIC's Cell Development Engineer, but neither is postdoc-shaped and neither was given its own entry. At MEET the Research Associate (E 13 TV-L) title has disappeared from the jobs page altogether, leaving only a student assistant role — following last run's HTTP 410 this looks like the position itself coming down, so the item has been changed to 'no vacancy'. HIU's open-positions page listed nothing at all. Cambridge Chemistry's postdoc count has fallen from five to two, and the listing shows no research area, so whether either is battery-related could not be determined. The ECS job board (jobs.electrochem.org) returned HTTP 403 for the fourth run running, so the Sandia item again could not be re-checked. data/pi_archive.json now holds 98 names but not one yet carries a flag, so no '2+ in archive' item was added this run either.

items.title: 포닥 모집 — 전산 설계 · 실험 합성/분석 · 머신러닝
items.title_en: Postdoc openings — computational design, experimental synthesis and characterisation, machine learning
items.desc: 2026-09-22 확인 시에도 에너지 소재의 전산 설계, 실험 합성·분석, 머신러닝/AI 세 분야로 포닥을 모집하고 있었습니다. 시작 시점은 협의 가능하며 국적 제한이 없다고 명시돼 있고, 지원은 전산(ceder-hr-comp@lbl.gov)과 실험(ceder-hr-exp@lbl.gov) 주소가 분리돼 있습니다. 개별 공고 전문은 하위 페이지(/openings/postdoctoral-positions/)로 안내됩니다.
items.desc_en: As of 22 September 2026 the group is still recruiting postdocs in three areas: computational design of energy materials, experimental synthesis and characterisation, and machine learning and AI. Starting dates are negotiable and the page states explicitly that there are no citizenship restrictions, with separate application addresses for computational (ceder-hr-comp@lbl.gov) and experimental (ceder-hr-exp@lbl.gov) roles. Full postings are signposted to a sub-page (/openings/postdoctoral-positions/).

The 19 August priority review date has passed, but the posting still states that applications are accepted until it is removed, so it remains open. The role is based in Berkeley on a two-year appointment.

items.desc_en: The Agratas 'Senior Solid-State Scientist' role carried last run was gone from the Faraday board as of 22 September 2026, replaced by a senior mechanical engineering post in lithium-ion cell development. Agratas is Tata Group's UK battery cell manufacturer. The board shows no closing date, so that must be checked against the posting itself.

items.desc_en: A senior battery-materials research role still on the Faraday board as of 22 September 2026. CPI is a UK process scale-up organisation, so the work sits closer to taking laboratory-scale materials to pilot scale. No closing date is shown, so it still needs re-checking.

items.deadline_en: Needs re-checking — no closing date shown on the board
items.desc: 2026-09-22 확인 시 Faraday 잡보드에 새로 보인 배터리 화학 연구직입니다. Integrals Power는 LFP·LMFP 양극재를 개발하는 영국 소재 기업으로, 박사 후 소재 개발 트랙에 해당합니다. 잡보드에는 직함과 고용주만 표시되고 마감일이나 상세 요건은 나오지 않아 개별 공고에서 확인해야 합니다.
items.desc_en: A battery chemistry research role newly visible on the Faraday board as of 22 September 2026. Integrals Power is a UK materials company developing LFP and LMFP cathode materials, so this is a post-PhD materials development track. The board shows only the title and employer — no closing date or detailed requirements — so those must be checked against the posting itself.

items.desc: 2026-09-22 확인 시 화학과 잡보드의 포닥 공고는 직전 5건에서 2건으로 줄었습니다 — MA50990(마감 9월 22일)과 MA50962 2인 모집(마감 10월 2일)입니다. 다만 이번에는 목록에 연구분야가 전혀 표시되지 않아 배터리·전기화학 과제인지 확인할 수 없었으므로 ‘확인 불가’로 둡니다.
items.desc_en: As of 22 September 2026 the department's job board has fallen from five open postdoc roles to two — MA50990 (closing 22 September) and MA50962, a two-post advert (closing 2 October). This time the listing showed no research area at all, so whether either is a battery or electrochemistry project could not be determined, and the item is left as undetermined.

items.desc_en: After the previous posting expired, no new one was confirmed as of 22 September 2026 either. The Faraday board still mentions postdoc roles in Oxford's Department of Engineering Science as a bundle, but they carry no closing date and are still not confirmed as belonging to this group, so they are not listed separately.
